rationale: Karpurapu's hands-on experience in machine learning and cloud computing complements Simone's deep technical expertise in cloud-native infrastructure and AI workloads—two sides of the same emerging challenge. Simone's conviction that GPU workloads are forcing fundamental changes to Kubernetes, combined with her product marketing leadership at infrastructure companies, could offer valuable perspective on how cutting-edge ML research translates to market-ready cloud infrastructure.
intro_message: Karpurapu himavanth, meet simone morellato — she leads marketing for cloud-native infrastructure at the intersection of AI workloads and Kubernetes, and would be a great resource to understand how ML research gets deployed at scale.
